name: Elemental Commixture (Mythic)
body:
You and your allies can create an irresistible magic vortex of elements.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Commixture.

Benefits: You and your allies can combine up to three elemental spells together. The bonuses for the commixtures stack, and up to two different secondary effects can be produced at the same time by the combination of the primary spell with each of the secondary spells. For example, if the primary spell is an earth spell and the secondary ones use air and fire, both the dust and lava secondary effects can be produced (but not the smoke effect, since secondary spells don’t combine with each other).

By expending one use of mythic power, you can reduce the casting time of one combined spell by 1 step (a standard action becomes a move action, a move action becomes a swift action, and a swift action becomes an immediate action). This stacks with Quicken Spell and other effects that allow to reduce a spell’s casting time.
